2125367449092751863.en_summary: It took Cisco 25.7 years to recover from the Dot Com bubble. Its $80.06 closing peak in March 2000 equals roughly $158 today. It would need to rise another 68% if we account for inflation.
2125367449092751863.zh_summary: 思科從互聯網泡沫中恢復花了25.7年。其2000年3月80.06美元的收盤高峰相當於今天約158美元。如果考慮通膨，它還需要再上漲68%。

ticker_notes.CSCO: Inflation-adjusted recovery from Dot Com peak

2125363876845732191.en_summary: Lending to a hyperscaler for 30 years now pays 162bp over Treasuries. A year ago AI giants were the safe bet. Now the market charges them the most.
2125363876845732191.zh_summary: 現在向超大規模公司借貸30年支付比國債高162個基點。一年前AI巨頭是安全押注。現在市場對他們收費最高。

2125363132528828543.en_summary: Cyber stocks at 50x earnings while massive cyber attacks happen basically daily is the funniest trade on the board. The product fails, the fear goes up, the budgets go up, the stock goes up.
2125363132528828543.zh_summary: 網路安全股在50倍盈利時，而大規模網路攻擊幾乎每天發生，是板上最有趣的交易。產品失敗，恐懼上升，預算上升，股價上升。

2125361216788779310.en_summary: SRuhle replies I’m not judging an ipo 3 days after - I’m acknowledging that under the new rules, execs and employees can sell 10% on day 1. And by holding off on going public for so long…. Lots of upside held.
2125361216788779310.zh_summary: SRuhle回覆我不是在IPO後3天評判 - 我是在承認在新規則下，高管和員工可以在第一天出售10%。而通過這麼久不上市……持有了很多上漲空間。

2125360291315933630.en_summary: Luke Gromen: What China has done 1973-now is what USA did 1850-1930. Trade breakdown back then drove deflation in creditor USA and currency weakness and inflation in indebted Europe. Same thing happening.
2125360291315933630.zh_summary: Luke Gromen：中國從1973年至今所做的是美國1850-1930年所做的。當時貿易崩潰推動了債權人美國的通縮以及負債歐洲的貨幣疲軟和通膨。同樣的事情正在發生。
